code: import axios from"axios";const BASE_URL="http://localhost:5001/api/wallet";export const getWalletSummary=async()=>{const response=await axios.get("".concat(BASE_URL,"/summary"));return response.data;};export const getWallets=async function(){let search=arguments.length>0&&arguments[0]!==undefined?arguments[0]:"";const response=await axios.get("".concat(BASE_URL,"/wallets"),{params:{search}});return response.data;};export const depositFunds=async amount=>{const response=await axios.post("".concat(BASE_URL,"/deposit"),{amount});return response.data;};export const withdrawFunds=async amount=>{const response=await axios.post("".concat(BASE_URL,"/withdraw"),{amount});return response.data;};export const transferFunds=async(toUserId,amount,equipment)=>{const response=await axios.post("".concat(BASE_URL,"/transfer"),{toUserId,amount,equipment});return response.data;};
